name: flixdesign-api
description: API Design Flix made on Node.js

scripts.test:server: cross-env NODE_ENV=test LOG_LEVEL=verbose node scripts/setEnv.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=test node src/main.js
scripts.dev:api: cross-env NODE_ENV=development LOG_LEVEL=debug node scripts/setEnv.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=development nodemon src/main.js
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=production LOG_LEVEL=info node scripts/setEnv.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node src/main.js
scripts.build-stg: node scripts/setEnv.js development && babel src --out-dir dist && npm run minify
scripts.build-prd: node scripts/setEnv.js production && babel src --out-dir dist && npm run minify
scripts.migrate: node scripts/setEnv.js development && npx sequelize-cli db:migrate
scripts.migrate:development: node scripts/setEnv.js development && npx sequelize-cli db:migrate
scripts.migrate:production: node scripts/setEnv.js production && npx sequelize-cli db:migrate
scripts.seed:admins: node scripts/setEnv.js development && npx sequelize-cli db:seed --seed 20260925180000-seed-default-admins.js
scripts.seed:admins:production: node scripts/setEnv.js production && npx sequelize-cli db:seed --seed 20260925180000-seed-default-admins.js
scripts.db:setup: node scripts/setEnv.js development && node scripts/setupLocalDb.js && node scripts/syncModels.js && node scripts/markMigrations.js

author: FlixDesign
